basic.name: Dazzling Blades
basic.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Sampo's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Ricochet Love
skill.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Sampo's ATK to a single enemy, and further deals DMG for 4 extra time(s), with each time dealing Wind DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of Sampo's ATK to a random enemy.

ultimate.name: Surprise Present
ultimate.description_template: Deals Wind DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Sampo's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance to increase the targets' DoT taken by {{scaling2}}% for 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Windtorn Dagger
talent.description_template: Sampo's attacks have a 65% base chance to inflict Wind Shear for 3 turn(s). Enemies inflicted with Wind Shear will take Wind DoT equal to {{scaling1}}% of Sampo's ATK at the beginning of each turn. Wind Shear can stack up to 5 time(s).

technique.name: Shining Bright
technique.description: After Sampo uses his Technique, enemies in a set area are afflicted with Blind for 10 second(s). Blinded enemies cannot detect ally targets. When initiating combat against a Blinded enemy, there is a 100% fixed chance to delay all enemies' action by 25%.

2.name: Trap
2.description: Extends the duration of Wind Shear caused by Talent by 1 turn(s).

6.name: Spice Up
6.description: Enemies with Wind Shear effect deal 15% less DMG to Sampo.

eidolons.name: Rising Love
eidolons.description: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time(s) to a random enemy.

eidolons.name: Infectious Enthusiasm
eidolons.description: Defeating an enemy afflicted with Wind Shear has a 100% base chance to inflict all enemies with 1 stack(s) of Wind Shear, equivalent to that of Skill.

eidolons.name: Big Money!
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: The Deeper the Love, the Stronger the Hate
eidolons.description: When Skill hits an enemy with 5 or more stack(s) of Wind Shear, the enemy immediately takes 8% of current Wind Shear DMG.

eidolons.name: Huuuuge Money!
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Increased Spending
eidolons.description: Talent's Wind Shear DMG multiplier increases by 15%.
